If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

name: hidden-power
effect: Power and type depend upon user’s IVs.  Power can range from 30 to 70.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs. Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.) Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5. Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table. Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

effect_full: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact. Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

name: play-nice
effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times.
flavor: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

name: mystical-fire
effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
flavor: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

effect_full: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.
flavor: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.

name: aromatic-mist

effect_full: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.
flavor: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

name: eerie-impulse
effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
flavor: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

effect: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.
flavor: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

effect: Explodes if the target uses a Fire move this turn, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP and preventing the move.
effect_full: Explodes if the target uses a Fire move this turn, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP and preventing the move.
flavor: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.

effect_full: Takes one turn to charge, then raises the user’s Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by two stages.
flavor: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.

effect: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.
effect_full: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.
flavor: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.

name: happy-hour
effect: Doubles prize money.
effect_full: Doubles prize money. Stacks with a held item. Only works once per battle.
flavor: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.

name: electric-terrain
effect: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.
effect_full: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Thunderbolt.
flavor: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

flavor: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

name: hold-hands
effect: Does nothing.

effect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

flavor: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.

effect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
flavor: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

name: hold-back
effect: Cannot lower the target’s HP below 1.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.
flavor: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.

name: infestation
effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.
flavor: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.

name: power-up-punch
effect: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
flavor: Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.

effect: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.

flavor: The user absorbs its target’s HP. The user’s HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.

effect: Grounds the target, and hits even Flying-type or levitating Pokémon.

flavor: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.

name: thousand-waves
effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.
flavor: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can’t flee from battle.

effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.

flavor: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.

effect_full: Heals the target for ½ its max HP. If Grassy Terrain is in effect, heals for ⅔ instead.
flavor: The user restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP. More HP is restored when the ground is Grassy Terrain.

name: high-horsepower
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

effect_full: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage. Heals the user by the target’s current Attack, including modifiers, but not including this move’s Attack-lowering effect. flavor: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.

name: solar-blade
effect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
flavor: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.

name: leafage
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.
flavor: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

effect_full: For the duration of the turn, if the target is also a valid target for a move used by one of its opponents, that move will target it instead.
flavor: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

effect_full: If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage. If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP.
flavor: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Traps the target.

effect: Protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and increases the power of their  Psychic moves by 50%.
effect_full: Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.
flavor: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

flavor: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

name: power-trip
effect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.
flavor: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

name: burn-up
effect: Removes the user’s Fire type after inflicting damage.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the user’s Fire type after damage calculation. If the user is not Fire-type, this move will fail.
flavor: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

name: speed-swap
effect: Exchanges the user’s Speed with the target’s.
effect_full: Exchanges the original Speed stats of the user and target.
flavor: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

name: smart-strike
effect: Never misses.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
flavor: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

name: purify
effect: Cures the target of a major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP.
effect_full: Cures the target of its major status ailment and heals the user for 50% of its max HP. If the target has no major status ailment, this move will fail.
flavor: The user heals the target’s status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user’s own HP.

name: revelation-dance

flavor: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

name: tera-starstorm
flavor: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

name: fickle-beam
flavor: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

name: burning-bulwark
flavor: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

name: thunderclap
flavor: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

name: mighty-cleave
flavor: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

name: tachyon-cutter
flavor: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

name: hard-press
flavor: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

name: dragon-cheer
flavor: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

name: alluring-voice
flavor: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

name: temper-flare
flavor: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

name: supercell-slam
flavor: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

name: psychic-noise
flavor: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

name: upper-hand
flavor: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

name: malignant-chain
flavor: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.

effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

name: shadow-break
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.

name: shadow-chill
effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

name: shadow-end
effect: User receives 1/2 its HP in recoil.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 of its current HP in recoil.

name: shadow-fire
effect: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

name: shadow-rave
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.

name: shadow-storm
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.

name: shadow-wave
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect_full: Inflicts regular damage.

effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

name: shadow-half
effect: Halves HP of all Pokémon on the field.  Must recharge
effect_full: Halves HP of all Pokémon on the field. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

name: shadow-hold
effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
effect_full: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

name: shadow-mist
effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by two stages.
effect_full: Lowers the target’s evasion by two stages.

name: shadow-panic
effect: Confuses the target.
effect_full: Confuses the target.

name: shadow-shed
effect: Removes Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
effect_full: Removes the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

name: shadow-sky
effect: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns.
effect_full: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns. Pokémon other than Shadow Pokémon take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. This move is typeless for the purposes of Weather Ball.
